{{Top|leg}}
'''Storage tank thirteen''' was a [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] tank near refueling [[Fuel City|station six]], in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fuel City]], located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]. It was destroyed by [[Jan Ors]], which prompted air-traffic controller [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zyak]] to leave his post.
